elements.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
elements.evidence: The Company may assign without HDI's consent to an affiliate.

elements.element: Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
elements.evidence: The Company may assign without HDI's consent to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all of its assets.

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
elements.evidence: HDI may not assign without the Company's prior written consent.

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: The Company's consent to HDI's assignment shall not be unreasonably withheld.

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
elements.evidence: HDI may assign 'in no event to a competitor of the Company.'

elements.element: Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
elements.evidence: No change of control of the Company gives HDI any right to terminate the Agreement.

elements.element: Both parties may assign to a successor.
elements.evidence: The Company has an express successor-assignment right, but HDI has no equivalent consent-free successor-assignment right; all HDI assignments require Company consent.

elements.element: A successor assignment requires written notice.
elements.evidence: The clause imposes no written-notice requirement for the Company's successor assignments; HDI's prior-written-consent requirement is not a mutual successor notice requirement.
The Company may assign to an affiliate without consent, and the clause does not expressly require consent for all other Company assignments.

elements.element: Consent to other assignments is not to be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: The reasonableness standard applies only to the Company's consent to HDI assignments, not mutually to consent for other assignments.
